panels.title: Real vs synthetic: ${sensor}
panels.description: Normalized values of one sensor, real stream against each synthetic generator.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_window" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dataset == "${dataset}" and r.sensor == "${sensor}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Anomaly score and threshold
panels.description: Online anomaly score of every record (Hazem, HalfSpaceTrees + z-score) and its threshold.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "anomaly_scores" and r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "anomaly_score" or r._field == "anomaly_threshold")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Alerts by type
panels.description: Number of ANOMALY and DRIFT alerts over time.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alerts" and r._field == "score" and r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> group(columns: ["type"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Similarity: MMD per generator
panels.description: Maximum Mean Discrepancy between real and synthetic windows (lower = more similar).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "similarity_metrics" and r._field == "mmd_score" and r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Forecast error: real vs synthetic training
panels.description: Online MAE of a forecaster trained on real data (TRTR) vs on synthetic data (TSTR).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "similarity_metrics" and r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "forecast_mae_real" or r._field == "forecast_mae_syn")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Distance metrics per generator
panels.description: Wasserstein, ACF difference and cross-correlation difference (lower = more similar).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "similarity_metrics" and r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "wasserstein" or r._field == "acf_diff" or r._field == "xcorr_diff")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
